summary: The enclosure is visually coherent and the intended sandwich layout is recognizable. The rear GPU/PSU structures and overall 120 x 190 x 205 mm chassis envelope are supported, but exact component fit, cooler clearance, and hidden cable/header paths cannot be fully established from the committed views alone.

checks.description: The enclosure reads as a complete, proportionate vertical assembly; the frame, perforated panels, internal mounts, and controls appear coherently placed without obvious floating parts or visible gross collisions.

evidence.description: The isometric overview visibly shows a coherent framed enclosure with integrated panels and internal structure.

checks.description: A motherboard tray and mounting features are visible, but no standard 170 x 170 mm motherboard envelope or dimensional evidence is shown in the cited view, so exact fit, retention, and rear-I/O accessibility are not established.

evidence.description: The view shows the internal tray arrangement but does not directly prove fit with a standard Mini-ITX board.

checks.description: The ventilated side and motherboard-side cavity are visible, but the AXP120-X67 envelope is not represented; exact cooler fit and intake clearance cannot be verified visually.

evidence.description: The front view shows the vented enclosure face but not a cooler envelope or measurable panel clearance.

checks.description: Rear GPU mounting and a riser passage are modeled, but the approved GPU envelope, connector/bracket engagement, and power-cable bend volume are not directly shown, preventing exact fit verification.

evidence.description: The assembly view indicates a rear mounting region, but no GPU envelope is present to prove all required clearances.

checks.description: A dedicated rear PSU cradle and ventilation are visible, but the specified 160 x 80 x 40 mm PSU envelope and AC connector/cable interfaces are not shown, so exact fit and service clearances remain unverified.

evidence.description: The isometric view shows the enclosure layout but lacks an explicit PSU envelope proving dimensional fit.

checks.description: An external front power button is clearly present and accessible, but the hidden internal route to the motherboard header is not established by these views.

evidence.description: The front view directly shows an externally accessible button, while its internal wiring path is not visible.

checks.description: The rear-side views clearly show the GPU mount above a separate PSU cradle on the opposite side of the motherboard tray, with both structures exposed toward the rear for service access.

evidence.description: The rear isometric view visibly distinguishes the upper GPU support region and lower PSU cradle behind the central tray.

checks.description: The focused rear views visibly show a tray pass-through, longitudinal GPU support structure, and rear bracket retention area consistent with the requested rear GPU interface.

evidence.description: The focused rear isometric view shows the riser passage and GPU support/mounting geometry together.

checks.description: A distinct lower rear PSU cradle, open rear interface/exhaust region, and adjacent cable-guide passage toward the motherboard side are visibly modeled.

evidence.description: The focused rear view visibly shows the independent PSU cradle and neighboring cable-routing feature.

checks.description: The model is clearly recognizable as a complete vertical ITX enclosure with structural frame, two ventilated sides, feet, front power control, and organized internal mounting features; no obvious floating fragments are visible.

evidence.description: The focused isometric overview directly shows the frame, vented enclosure panels, power button, and foot structures as one coherent product.

checks.description: The chassis is visibly a substantial two-sided sandwich enclosure rather than an implausibly compressed shell. Supporting geometry inspection reports the chassis frame bounding box as 120 x 190 x 205 mm, corresponding to approximately 4.67 L and matching the stated envelope.

evidence.description: The isometric view visibly shows the full sandwich chassis volume reserved for structures on both sides of the tray; bbox inspection separately supports the stated dimensions.
